'''Cave wheat''' is an [[underground]] [[crop]]. It can either be [[milling|milled]] into [[flour|dwarven wheat flour]] or [[brewing|brewed]] into [[Alcohol|dwarven beer]].

Cave wheat [[seed|seeds]] can be brought as an [[embark]] item and imported from [[Trading|dwarven caravans]].  They are planted in the summer or autumn seasons and require about 42 days to grow.

Some [[dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] cave wheat for its ''stalks''.
